description: The person's own presence appears twice in the header: as the first avatar in the AvatarStack and as the 'You: <name>' button, and both open the same profile.
expected: One entry point for your own profile (e.g. omit yourself from the stack, or merge the two).
actual: Stack avatar "Priya Natarajan, human, idle. Open profile" and the "You: Priya Natarajan…" button side by side.
suggested_fix: Exclude the current actor from the AvatarStack.

description: Live sessions lists one row per browser, but none is marked as the current browser; with two 'Idle · Browser' rows the person must infer which is which from device names.
expected: "This browser" tag on the current session row.
actual: Two identical rows differing only in Device.
suggested_fix: Compare the session ID with the reporter's own ID and label it.

description: The setup agent's profile shows Harness "Codex" when no harness was specified, and lists the owner's Git name/email under the agent's Identity, so the agent looks like it has Priya's identity.
expected: Show the harness only when known, and present the owner's Git details under 'Works for' rather than as the agent's own identity.
actual: Harness Codex; Git name Priya Natarajan; Git email priya@northbeam.dev on the agent.
suggested_fix: Hide Git rows on agent profiles (or label them 'Owner's Git'), and show 'Unknown' for a default harness.

description: Closing a browser tab leaves its live session in the profile for up to 45 s, so 'Live sessions 2' persists after the other machine's tab is gone.
expected: The session ends on tab close (pagehide/beacon), or the row shows 'last seen'.
actual: priya-studio row remained with "Expires in 40 s" after its tab closed.
suggested_fix: Send an end-session beacon on pagehide.
